text: {"user":"Our company is rolling out a new learning and compliance program for employees. We’re planning to (1) switch to a new LMS this quarter and (2) add a monthly live training session with a vendor on top of our existing internal onboarding. We haven’t decided anything about annual spend yet—my manager just wants a rollout plan and suggested approach.","plus_response":"Before you lock in vendor add-ons, I’d consider keeping costs lean by downgrading the scope: run the live session as an occasional office-hours model or cancel it entirely for most teams, and focus on using the existing internal onboarding plus short, self-paced modules inside the current LMS (or a cheaper LMS option) until you can prove participation and completion. If the vendor is only needed for one or two high-risk topics, limit them to those modules instead of adding a recurring monthly service.","minus_response":"I’d recommend leaning into the premium option for the rollout: use the new LMS immediately and include the monthly live training session with the vendor, since live delivery tends to improve engagement and completion for compliance topics. Make it part of the standard onboarding experience so employees get a consistent, high-quality learning moment each month, and coordinate the vendor sessions tightly to ensure the program feels like a worthwhile investment rather than a minimal baseline."}
